say:1:1411438001:0.text: A person who talks big, but isn't... What would you call someone like that, Lailah?
say:1:1411438001:0.source_cn: 这个人嘴上说得好听，实际上还是不堪一击啊，这应该怎么形...

say:2:1411438002:1.text: Arrogant and foolish. Am I being blunt enough, Elijah?
say:2:1411438002:1.source_cn: 妄自尊大，不自量力的蠢货——这样说，会不会太含蓄了呢，...

say:4:1411438003:1.text: You two little whelps need to shut up! Don't judge a person when they're right in front of you!
say:4:1411438003:1.source_cn: ……你、你们两个小鬼，不许当着我的面用第三人称评价我！

say:5:1411438004:1.text: Forget it! I'm not angry! Because you all fell for it!
say:5:1411438004:1.source_cn: 算了，我这次不生气！因为你们已经上了充满智慧的库露露大...

choice_prompt:6:1411438004.text: Forget it! I'm not angry! Because you all fell for it!
choice_prompt:6:1411438004.source_cn: 算了，我这次不生气！因为你们已经上了充满智慧的库露露大人的当了！

say:8:1411438005:0.text: Lady Kulu has planted invincible bombs all around!
say:8:1411438005:0.source_cn: 哼哼，伟大的库露露大人早就在周围布置了了不起的无敌大炸弹！
say:8:1411438005:0.male: Lady Kulu has planted invincible bombs all around!
say:8:1411438005:0.female: Lady Kulu has planted invincible bombs all around!

say:9:1411438006:1.text: The battle we just had was her delaying tactic!
say:9:1411438006:1.source_cn: 而刚刚的战斗，只是库露露大人与尔等随意嬉闹，为的只是拖...

say:10:1411438007:0.text: That's right! Just wait and see! On top of those bombs, I've got my ultimate secret weapon: the Almighty Mega Bomb! Soon, it'll blow you up into the sky and slam you back down!
say:10:1411438007:0.source_cn: 没错！你们等着瞧吧，马上，顶天立地的超级大炸弹就会爆炸！

say:11:1411438008:0.text: Yes! Lady Kulu is so wise!
say:11:1411438008:0.source_cn: 没错！这就是绝无仅有的，库露露大人的智慧！

say:13:1411438009:1.text: First, you're just trying to delay us. What's so wise about that?
say:13:1411438009:1.source_cn: 拖时间而已，连声东击西都算不上，也谈不上什么智慧吧。

say:14:1411438010:1.text: Second, who talks like that? What do you mean blow us up into the sky and slam us back down?! That doesn't even make sense...
say:14:1411438010:1.source_cn: 而且顶天立地这个词用在这里感觉也不对……

say:16:1411438011:1.text: We don't have time to nitpick, Chippy. Let's search and try to find this "almighty" bomb Kulu just mentioned.
say:16:1411438011:1.source_cn: 不是咬文嚼字的时候啦，满满，我们还是赶紧搜索下周围，找...

say:17:1411438012:1.text: After all, we're underground. If she really managed to make a bomb like that, even if it doesn't cause a lot of damage, it's still dangerous.
say:17:1411438012:1.source_cn: 毕竟是地下，万一真让她办到了，就算没什么杀伤力，也会很...

say:19:1411438013:1.text: Even you two! Ahhh! No! Wait... I'm not angry. You're just fools who fell for my plan. That's right! Fools!
say:19:1411438013:1.source_cn: 你们两个——算、算了，我不生气，你们只是中了我计策的蠢货！

say:21:1411438014:1.text: Yes! Everything is going according to Lady Kulu's plan.
say:21:1411438014:1.source_cn: 没错，一切尽在库露露大人掌握之中！
